jobs.title: Network Head/Lead
jobs.description:
About RackBank Datacenters:
RackBank Datacenters is a fast-growing and trusted data center company committed to powering digital transformation with secure, scalable, and efficient IT infrastructure solutions. With state-of-the-art data centers in India and a strong client base across multiple industries, RackBank is focused on delivering next-gen cloud and colocation services.

Our Vision:
To build India’s most reliable and trusted data center and digital infrastructure ecosystem, empowering enterprises and governments with secure, scalable, and future-ready infrastructure.

Why join RackBank:
Be part of a high-trust, ownership-driven work culture
Gain exposure to real-world infrastructure operations and decision-making
Grow with the organization as we expand our data center footprint
Freedom to take initiative and own outcomes, not just tasks
Make a meaningful impact in building India’s digital infrastructure backbone

Role Overview:
This is a founding leadership role for the Network function at RackBank. You will be the first dedicated Network Head — joining a small, high-velocity team with a clear mandate: build an enterprise-grade network operations practice from the ground up.
You will architect and commission the Raipur DC network, define L1/L2/L3 team structures, own ISP and peering relationships, drive cloud networking for NeevCloudAI, and maintain 99.99% uptime across all existing infrastructure. If you have deep datacenter networking expertise and the builder’s mindset to match, this role is built for you.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Network Architecture & DC Commissioning
  • Design and commission the end-to-end network architecture for the Raipur Datacenter — spine-leaf topology, core/distribution/access layers,   ODF, patch management, and inter-DC connectivity.
  • Define IP addressing plans, VLAN segmentation, routing policies, and redundancy design across Indore and Raipur sites.
  • Evaluate, procure, and deploy networking hardware (Cisco Nexus/ASR, Juniper MX/QFX, or Arista) aligned to capacity and growth plans.
  • Establish network acceptance testing (NAT) frameworks and handover checklists for new infrastructure.
  • Define and maintain network capacity plans; forecast bandwidth, port density, and hardware refresh cycles.
2. BGP, ISP & Peering Management
  • Own RackBank’s AS and public IP (IPv4/IPv6) address space — including APNIC/IRINN coordination and RPKI/ROA management.
  • Manage multi-homed ISP relationships: SLA negotiation, traffic engineering, failover policies, and bandwidth upgrades.
  • Establish and maintain IXP and private peering relationships to optimize latency, cost, and redundancy.
  • Implement BGP route policies, prefix filtering, community tagging, and inbound/outbound traffic balancing.
  • Monitor BGP session health, prefix counts, and route leaks; respond to peering incidents rapidly.
3. Cloud & Overlay Networking (NeevCloudAI)
  • Design and operate the overlay network layer for NeevCloudAI — VXLAN/EVPN-based tenant isolation, SDN integration, and multi-tenancy routing.
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering to integrate network abstractions into cloud orchestration (OpenStack Neutron, Kubernetes CNI).
  • Build and maintain network security boundaries for cloud tenants — micro-segmentation, security groups, and flow monitoring.
  • Drive network automation to eliminate manual provisioning: Ansible, Netconf/YANG, Python scripting, or similar tooling.
  • Contribute to the NeevCloudAI product roadmap on network-dependent capabilities (dedicated cloud connect, private VLANs, DDoS protection).
4. WAN, SD-WAN & MPLS
  • Manage and optimize WAN connectivity between Indore HQ and Raipur DC — MPLS circuit management, SLA enforcement, and failover testing.
  • Evaluate and implement SD-WAN solutions where applicable for cost optimization and intelligent path control.
  • Coordinate with telco vendors on circuit provisioning, fault resolution, and planned maintenance windows.
  • Maintain WAN topology documentation and drive regular DR drills for inter-site failover.
5. Team Building & NOC Operations
  • Define and hire the L1/L2/L3 network operations team structure — roles, responsibilities, shift schedules, escalation paths, and KPIs.
  • Build the Network Operations Center (NOC) framework: monitoring dashboards, alerting thresholds, incident playbooks, and SLA reporting.
  • Establish and enforce SOPs for change management, incident response, capacity planning, and vendor management.
  • Drive a culture of RCA, documentation, and continuous improvement; conduct regular team reviews and skill development planning.
  • Serve as the final escalation point (L3) for complex network incidents until the team is fully staffed and capable.
6. Network Security & Compliance
  • Own network-layer security posture: firewall rule governance, ACL lifecycle management, DDoS mitigation strategy, and perimeter hardening.
  • Collaborate with the Security team on vulnerability assessments, pentest remediation, and compliance requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CERT-In).
  • Implement and regularly audit network access controls, ZTNA principles, and audit log frameworks.
  • Ensure all network changes follow a reviewed, approved, and logged change management process.
7. Vendor & Leadership Stakeholder Management
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact with ISPs, hardware OEMs, and DC colocation vendors.
  • Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering to define and scope customer-facing network offerings (dedicated links, MPLS, cloud connect, SLA tiers).
  • Present network health, capacity, incident, and project status reports to CTO and leadership at a regular cadence.
  • Drive vendor evaluation and RFP processes for major network infrastructure investments.
Requirements:
Must-Have
  • 8–12+ years in network engineering, with at least 3 years leading a team or function in a datacenter, hosting, ISP, or cloud environment.
  • Proven hands-on experience designing and commissioning datacenter networks — spine-leaf, multi-tier architectures, physical layer, and ODF planning.
  • Deep expertise in BGP (iBGP/eBGP), OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, and IP routing in a carrier or hosting environment.
  • Hands-on experience with DC-grade hardware: Cisco Nexus/Catalyst/ASR, Juniper MX/EX/QFX, or Arista EOS.
  • Solid understanding of VXLAN, EVPN, and overlay networking principles for multi-tenant cloud environments.
  • Experience managing public IP space (APNIC/IRINN), multi-homed BGP, ISP SLAs, and peering relationships.
  • Network security expertise: firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco ASA/FTD), ACLs, DDoS mitigation, and network segmentation.
  • Experience building NOC practices: monitoring (Zabbix, Nagios, PRTG, LibreNMS, Grafana), alerting, and escalation frameworks.
  • Certifications: CCIE (R&S, DC, or SP), JNCIE, or equivalent professional-level certification strongly preferred.
Good to Have
  • Experience with SD-WAN platforms: Cisco Viptela, VMware VeloCloud, or Fortinet Secure SD-WAN.
  • Familiarity with OpenStack Neutron, Kubernetes CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium), or cloud-native networking stacks.
  • Network automation experience: Ansible playbooks, Python (Netmiko, Nornir), Terraform for network infra, or Netconf/YANG.
  • Exposure to IXP peering, transit optimization, or CDN interconnection in an Indian DC/hosting environment.
  • Familiarity with CERT-In guidelines, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 compliance in a datacenter context.
  • Prior experience commissioning or operating a greenfield datacenter in India.
Education
  • B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Professional networking certifications (CCIE, JNCIE) are strongly preferred and may substitute for formal degree requirements.
What We Offer
•    A founding network leadership role with full autonomy to build the team and architecture from scratch.
•    Direct reporting line to CTO with high strategic influence and executive visibility.
•    Opportunity to commission a greenfield datacenter (Raipur DC) from architecture to go-live.
